StreamEvent.description:
Server-sent event payload emitted by ``GET /api/events``.

Carries only identifiers, location names, threat levels, kinds, and query keys to
invalidate — never coordinates, distances, or bearings.

at.description: UTC instant when the event was published.
at.title: At

invalidate.description: Query keys that open dashboard pages must refetch.
invalidate.title: Invalidate

runner.description: Runner that executed the cycle, or null.
runner.title: Runner

trigger.description: Trigger that initiated the cycle, or null.
trigger.title: Trigger

status.description: Cycle or snapshot completion status, or null.
status.title: Status

snapshot_id.description: Stored snapshot identifier (set on snapshot events), or null.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

location.description: Watched location name (set on assessment, alert, notification, and location events), or null.
location.title: Location

assessment_id.description: Stored assessment identifier (set on assessment, alert, and notification events), or null.
assessment_id.title: Assessment Id

level.description: Threat level integer from 1 to 5 (set on assessment and notification events), or null.
level.title: Level

complete.description: Whether the stored assessment had every required input (set on assessment events), or null.
complete.title: Complete

notification_id.description: Stored notification identifier (set on notification events), or null.
notification_id.title: Notification Id

notification_kind.description: Notification category (set on notification events), or null.

body.description: Notification body lines when delivered for display, or null.

display.title: Display
